description: The four-star tower-one save refuses placements a one-star tower cannot reach, each named by the reason the engine gives: parking and a ramp above the basement, a two-story cinema with no floors above it, an office on a sky-lobby concourse tile, a floor on a sky lobby story, and, on a new sky story at floor 60, a sky lobby over a room and then a room on a claimed sky lobby story. Two settled hours follow. The wedding hall's floor-100 rule stays unreachable below five stars, where the star lock fires first.
